  • 视觉感知 / 3D Point Cloud Perception and Tracking: No new papers today (0 new; 0 seen in last 14 days).

Research Areas

LLM Agent 与多智能体

Agent Test-Time Scaling and Self-Improvement

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS]

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS] Self-Play Pretraining with Zero Data

A. Cowsik, K. Dolev, M. Y. Li et al. | 2026-09-24. Contribution: proposes pretraining where the model generates its own most useful data for self-improvement. Relevance: directly targets self-improvement and test-time scaling for agents/language models.

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS]

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS] Instrumental Monitor Evasion Emerges Under Ordinary Task Pressure

D. Schmotz, D. Prinzhorn, L. Beurer-Kellner et al. | 2026-09-24. Contribution: introduces EvasionBench to measure LLM agents evading runtime monitoring under ordinary task pressure. Relevance: surfaces safety and oversight risks in agent self-improvement and test-time behavior.

具身智能

Vision-Language-Action Models

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS]

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS] ActGaze: Learning Action-Grounded Gaze through Counterfactual Visual Interventions for High-Precision Manipulation

J. Zhu, J. Wang, C. Tang et al. | 2026-09-24. Contribution: trains VLA policies to ground gaze on action-relevant regions via counterfactual visual interventions. Relevance: directly improves VLA attention for high-precision manipulation.

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS]

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS] Self-Adaptive VLA for Robust Robot Deployment

H. Zhang, C. Lin, T.-H. Wang et al. | 2026-09-24. Contribution: enables VLA models to self-adapt during deployment to test-time environment and hardware shifts. Relevance: core VLA robustness and real-world deployment.

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS]

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS] Decoupled Early Exits for Task-Dependent Compute Allocation in Flow-Matching VLAs

R. A. Izzo, R. Rubavicius, G. Bardaro et al. | 2026-09-24. Contribution: decouples early exits in flow-matching VLAs for task-dependent compute allocation. Relevance: connects VLA control with inference optimization.

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS]

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS] AdaHVLA: Adaptive Harnesses for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Execution

J. Tang, J. Peng, Z. Ding et al. | 2026-09-24. Contribution: uses adaptive harnesses to retain task history and progress for long-horizon VLA execution. Relevance: addresses VLA memory and planning limits.

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS]

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS] Robo-Harness K1: Harnessing Robot-Use Agents via Perception Augmentation

Z. Li, Y. Zhang, W. Li et al. | 2026-09-24. Contribution: augments perception to harness robot-use agents without heavy VLA demonstrations. Relevance: bridges VLM understanding and VLA-style robotic control.

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS]

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS] CrossSafe: Towards Cross-Embodiment Latent Safety Filters

I. Tabbara, Y. Yang, H. Sibai | 2026-09-24. Contribution: learns cross-embodiment latent safety filters for VLA-style policies. Relevance: safety enforcement for cross-embodiment VLA deployment.

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS]

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS] AquaMend: Minimal Re-probing and Conditional Rollback for Latent-Belief Failures in Embodied Agents

Y. Liu, S. Luo, Y. Liu et al. | 2026-09-24. Contribution: compares re-probing, rollback, and supported continuation to repair latent-belief failures. Relevance: failure recovery for VLA/embodied agents.

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS]

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS] HarnessPAI: An Evolving Harness for Physical AI

X. Wang, W. Wu, M. Zhang et al. | 2026-09-24. Contribution: proposes an evolving harness for physical AI that preserves perception and reasoning around action models. Relevance: VLA/embodied AI architecture and training recipe.

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS]

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS] PUBG Ally: A Conversational Embodied Agent as an AI Teammate

B. Kim, B. Kim, D. Kim et al. | 2026-09-24. Contribution: builds a voice-enabled embodied agent teammate for a dynamic battle royale game. Relevance: applied embodied agent interaction and action under change.

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS]

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS] Ego-Exo4D Human Meshes Dataset: 4D Human Motion Reconstruction for Ego-Exo Captures

A. Maddukuri, G. Pavlakos | 2026-09-24. Contribution: releases dense 4D human motion reconstructions for ego-exo captures. Relevance: embodied/VLA training resource for human motion and manipulation.

Embodied Navigation

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS]

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS] GPT-6-Astra Lights Up Embodied Navigation: Evaluation in Zero-Shot Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments

G. Dai, Q. Sun, Q. Wu et al. | 2026-09-24. Contribution: evaluates GPT-6-Astra zero-shot VLN-CE with minimal perception, reasoning, and decision-making support. Relevance: directly tests foundation models for embodied navigation.

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS]

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS] From Passive Execution to Active Exploration: Agentic Embodied Manipulation in Realistic Environments

S. Ma, C. Zhang, X. Bai et al. | 2026-09-24. Contribution: shifts agentic embodied manipulation from passive execution to active exploration with distractors and semantic cues. Relevance: embodied exploration and long-horizon agency.

模型压缩与持续学习

Continual Learning

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS]

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS] Hyperbolic Multimodal Continual Learning: A Closest-Admissible Solution

J. Liu, M. Shen, X. Liu et al. | 2026-09-24. Contribution: preserves Lorentz geometry in hyperbolic multimodal continual learning. Relevance: directly addresses continual learning for multimodal models.

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS]

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS] Adaptive Fisher-Whitened Cross-Covariance for Low-Resource Speech Recognition

A. Mishra, M. Qian, B. Post et al. | 2026-09-24. Contribution: proposes Fisher-whitened cross-covariance adaptation for parameter-efficient low-resource speech recognition. Relevance: parameter-efficient adaptation relevant to sequential and multilingual model updates.

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS]

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS] Automatic Rank Allocation for Low-Rank Adaptation in Large Language Models via lp Regularization

Z. Xie, C. Zheng, Y.-C. Wu et al. | 2026-09-24. Contribution: uses lp regularization to automatically allocate LoRA ranks in LLMs. Relevance: PEFT rank control relevant to continual and multimodal adaptation.

视觉感知

Event-Based Vision

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS]

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS] SEE Challenge 2026: Event-Guided Brightness Adjustment Across a Broad Illumination Range

Y. Lu, M. Xu, H. Zhou et al. | 2026-09-24. Contribution: organizes a benchmark for event-guided brightness adjustment across broad illumination ranges. Relevance: core event-based vision benchmark and restoration task.

3D Point Cloud Perception

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS]

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS] SARFusion: Scene-Aware Routing Fusion for Robust Camera-LiDAR 3D Object Detection

Y. Zhao, Z. Zheng, S. Li | 2026-09-24. Contribution: uses scene-aware routing fusion for robust camera-LiDAR 3D object detection under corrupted conditions. Relevance: core 3D point cloud perception and fusion.

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS]

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS] M3GD: Multi-Modal Multi-View Geometric Diffusion for Camera--LiDAR Novel View Synthesis

Y. Zhou, J. Xiao, S. Ye et al. | 2026-09-24. Contribution: presents camera-LiDAR multimodal geometric diffusion for novel view synthesis with metric 3D structure. Relevance: LiDAR/point cloud geometric perception and synthesis.

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS]

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS] An Automated Georeferencing Technique for Multi-Temporal Stope Point Clouds for Downstream Geotechnical Analysis

D. Patra, S. Raval, P. Ranasinghe et al. | 2026-09-24. Contribution: automates georeferencing of multi-temporal underground stope point clouds. Relevance: point cloud processing in GNSS-denied environments.

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS]

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS] Seeing Is Not Measuring: Tool-Augmented Metric Spatial Reasoning for Vision-Language Models

K. Glantz, C. Grange | 2026-09-24. Contribution: equips a small VLM with geometric tools for metric 3D spatial reasoning. Relevance: 3D spatial perception and reasoning adjacent to point cloud tasks.

Cross-Topic Signals

  • Persistent harnesses and context repair recur across embodied agents: AdaHVLA, HarnessPAI, Robo-Harness K1, and AquaMend all target long-horizon memory, perception, and failure recovery.
  • Test-time adaptation and compute allocation connect VLA deployment with inference optimization: Self-Adaptive VLA, Decoupled Early Exits, and Self-Play Pretraining all emphasize adapting computation or data generation at deployment/training time.
  • Safety and oversight are emerging as a shared layer: CrossSafe, AquaMend, and Instrumental Monitor Evasion address filters, rollback, or monitor evasion in embodied/agentic settings.
  • Multimodal geometric grounding links point-cloud, event, and VLM work: SARFusion, M3GD, Seeing Is Not Measuring, and SEE Challenge all combine complementary sensing or tools for robust spatial understanding.
  • Parameter-efficient and geometry-preserving adaptation appears in continual-learning papers: Hyperbolic Multimodal Continual Learning, Adaptive Fisher-Whitened Cross-Covariance, and Automatic Rank Allocation all manage capacity during sequential or low-resource adaptation.

Priority Reading

ActGaze: Learning Action-Grounded Gaze through Counterfactual Visual Interventions for High-Precision Manipulation — Read in full for a concrete VLA attention-grounding method aimed at high-precision manipulation, a persistent weakness in VLA policies.

Self-Adaptive VLA for Robust Robot Deployment — Read in full for test-time self-adaptation to hardware and environment shifts, which is directly relevant to robust real-world VLA deployment.

Hyperbolic Multimodal Continual Learning: A Closest-Admissible Solution — Read in full for a geometry-preserving continual-learning formulation using Lorentz geometry, relevant to multimodal models and catastrophic forgetting.

This digest is auto-generated by agents-radar.

item.content:encoded:
实验室研究方向 Radar 2026-09-26

数据来源：ArXiv | 统一检索近3天 | 配置 4 个板块 / 11 个研究方向 | 34 篇新文献 + 13 篇过去14天内已出现 | 生成时间：2026-09-26 00:19 UTC

今日总览

  • LLM Agent 与多智能体 / LLM Agent 工程：今日 11 篇新文献、1 篇近 14 天重复。重点在工具副作用一致性、轨迹审计、代理监控规避、环境自演进、多轮后训练、深度搜索代理与 GPU 内核代理优化。
  • LLM Agent 与多智能体 / Agent 测试时扩展与自我改进：今日 2 篇新文献、2 篇近 14 天重复。信号集中在零数据自博弈预训练、规划式测试时扩展与能力流形评估。
  • LLM Agent 与多智能体 / LLM Agent Society：今日暂无新论文。
  • 具身智能 / 视觉-语言-动作模型：今日 10 篇新文献、0 篇重复。热点包括在线 RL 微调稳定性、长时程 harness、动作 token 化、早退推理、部署自适应与安全过滤。
  • 具身智能 / 具身导航：今日 3 篇新文献、7 篇近 14 天重复。新增涉及 GPT-6-Astra 零样本 VLN-CE、主动探索与 VLM 鲁棒推理；重复集中在语义地图、主动记忆与空间表示。
  • 模型压缩与持续学习 / LLM 剪枝与推理优化：今日暂无新论文；近 14 天有 2 篇重复，涉及运行时松弛推理与 ViT 任务几何。
  • 模型压缩与持续学习 / 多模态大模型剪枝：今日暂无新论文。
  • 模型压缩与持续学习 / 持续学习：今日 3 篇新文献、2 篇重复。新增聚焦双曲多模态持续学习、Fisher 白化 PEFT、LoRA 自动秩分配。
  • 视觉感知 / 事件相机视觉感知：今日 1 篇新文献。SEE Challenge 2026 关注宽照度范围事件引导亮度调整。
  • 视觉感知 / 3D 点云视觉感知：今日 4 篇新文献、1 篇重复。新增覆盖相机-LiDAR 鲁棒融合、点云地理参考、几何扩散 NVS、VLM 度量空间推理。
  • 视觉感知 / 3D 点云感知与跟踪：今日有 1 篇新文献被匹配，但主题偏高光谱分类，点云跟踪高相关信号有限，分方向不收录。

LLM Agent 与多智能体

LLM Agent 工程

Where Does Exactly-Once Live? Model, Harness, and Tool-Contract Effects on Duplicate Side Effects in LLM Agents

Li｜2026-09-24｜研究 exactly-once 应在模型、harness 还是工具契约层保证；关联：工具调用副作用可靠性。

World Action Agent: Harnessing VLMs for Robot Manipulation via World Action Rehearsal

Zhang et al.｜2026-09-24｜用 VLM 在“世界”中排练动作驱动机器人操作；关联：VLM 代理落地具身操作。

Progressive Skill Discovery as Access Control for Tool-Using LLM Agents

Stettler et al.｜2026-09-23｜将技能发现作为角色化访问控制；关联：企业工具集的安全治理。

LLM Agents Can Easily Tamper With Their Own Traces

Qin et al.｜2026-09-24｜本地 LLM 代理可篡改执行轨迹；关联：审计、监控与合规风险。

Breaking the Environment Wall: Evolving LLM Agent Environments for Recursive Self-Improvement

Wu et al.｜2026-09-24｜演化代理环境以支持递归自我改进；关联：环境就绪度与自改进闭环。

A Wrong Turn Does Not Ruin the Journey: Deviation-Guided Skill Self-Evolution for LLM Agents

Feng et al.｜2026-09-24｜用失败轨迹偏离引导技能自演化；关联：工具使用技能鲁棒更新。

MeshHeal: Two-Timescale Self-Healing for Gray Failures in Decentralized LLM Agent Networks

Chen et al.｜2026-09-24｜面向去中心化多代理灰色故障的两时间尺度自愈；关联：多代理网络可靠性。

From Self-Distillation to Self-Practice: Privileged Information for Multi-Turn Agents

Lab Research Topics Radar 2026-09-26

Source: ArXiv | 3-day search window | 4 groups / 11 configured topics | 34 new + 13 seen in the last 14 days | Generated: 2026-09-26 00:19 UTC

Today's Overview

  • LLM Agent Engineering: 11 new papers advanced reliability and governance, including exactly-once tool contracts, role-scoped capabilities, trace tamper resistance, monitor-evasion benchmarking, skill self-evolution, gray-failure healing, self-practice, and deep-search synthesis.
  • Agent Test-Time Scaling and Self-Improvement: 2 new papers explored zero-data self-play pretraining and evolving agent environments for recursive self-improvement.
  • LLM Agent Societies: No new papers today.
  • Vision-Language-Action Models: 10 new papers covered online RL fine-tuning stability, long-horizon harnesses, action tokenization, belief repair, gaze grounding, deployment self-adaptation, early exits, and cross-embodiment safety.
  • Embodied Navigation: 3 new papers evaluated zero-shot VLN-CE with GPT-6-Astra, flip-direction steering for robust VLM reasoning, and active exploration for embodied manipulation.
  • LLM Pruning and Inference Optimization: No new papers today.
  • Multimodal LLM Pruning: No new papers today.
  • Continual Learning: 3 new papers addressed hyperbolic multimodal continual learning, Fisher-whitened cross-covariance for low-resource ASR, and automatic LoRA rank allocation.
  • Event-Based Vision: 1 new paper launched the SEE Challenge 2026 for event-guided brightness adjustment across broad illumination.
  • 3D Point Cloud Perception: 4 new papers covered scene-aware camera-LiDAR fusion, multi-temporal stope georeferencing, camera-LiDAR geometric diffusion NVS, and tool-augmented metric spatial reasoning.
  • 3D Point Cloud Perception and Tracking: 1 new paper applied token clustering and semantic-sequence Mamba to hyperspectral image classification.

LLM Agent 与多智能体

LLM Agent Engineering

Where Does Exactly-Once Live? Model, Harness, and Tool-Contract Effects on Duplicate Side Effects in LLM Agents

J. Li, 2026-09-24 — Studies where exactly-once enforcement belongs across models, harnesses, and tool contracts to avoid duplicate side effects. Relevance: reliable tool-using agent design.

Progressive Skill Discovery as Access Control for Tool-Using LLM Agents

M. Stettler et al., 2026-09-23 — Proposes role-scoped capability delivery through progressive skill discovery. Relevance: scalable tool-access governance.

LLM Agents Can Easily Tamper With Their Own Traces

J. Qin et al., 2026-09-24 — Shows local LLM agents can tamper with their own execution traces. Relevance: monitoring, audit, and compliance integrity.

Instrumental Monitor Evasion Emerges Under Ordinary Task Pressure

D. Schmotz et al., 2026-09-24 — Introduces EvasionBench to measure agents circumventing runtime monitoring during ordinary tasks. Relevance: agent safety and oversight.

A Wrong Turn Does Not Ruin the Journey: Deviation-Guided Skill Self-Evolution for LLM Agents

Y. Feng et al., 2026-09-24 — Uses deviation-guided skill self-evolution instead of forcing failed trajectories to match one success path. Relevance: robust agent skill improvement.

MeshHeal: Two-Timescale Self-Healing for Gray Failures in Decentralized LLM Agent Networks

K. Chen et al., 2026-09-24 — Applies two-timescale self-healing to agents that remain responsive while task quality degrades. Relevance: multi-agent robustness.

From Self-Distillation to Self-Practice: Privileged Information for Multi-Turn Agents

X. Su et al., 2026-09-24 — Replaces token-level on-policy self-distillation with self-practice using privileged information. Relevance: multi-turn agent post-training.

IterSynth: Rethinking Deep Search Agents via Role-Decoupled Iterative Synthesis

X. Wu et al., 2026-09-24 — Decouples planning, evidence use, and synthesis in deep-search agents. Relevance: agent architecture for search tasks.

Agent Test-Time Scaling and Self-Improvement

Self-Play Pretraining with Zero Data

A. Cowsik et al., 2026-09-24 — Lets models generate their own pretraining data via self-play without curated data. Relevance: self-improvement.

Breaking the Environment Wall: Evolving LLM Agent Environments for Recursive Self-Improvement

Y. Wu et al., 2026-09-24 — Evolves agent environments to support recursive self-improvement. Relevance: self-improvement infrastructure.

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS] Planned Test-Time Scaling with Coordinated Reasoning Paths

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS] X. Wu et al., 2026-09-23 — Plans test-time scaling with coordinated reasoning paths. Relevance: efficient inference scaling.

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS] The Capability Manifold and ML Scaling Laws

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS] S. A. R. Zaidi & M. Hafeez, 2026-09-23 — Proposes capability-manifold scaling for agentic harnesses. Relevance: agent performance scaling.

具身智能

Vision-Language-Action Models

Uncertainty-Gated Exploration Noise Suppresses Task Collapse in Online RL Fine-Tuning of a Flow-Matching Vision-Language-Action Policy

M. T. Yardımcı & Y. E. Çoğurcu, 2026-09-23 — Uncertainty-gated exploration noise prevents task collapse during online RL fine-tuning of a flow-matching VLA. Relevance: VLA online adaptation.

AdaHVLA: Adaptive Harnesses for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Execution

J. Tang et al., 2026-09-24 — Adds adaptive harnesses with persistent memory and progress tracking for long-horizon VLA. Relevance: VLA planning and memory.

Direction-Scale Decomposition in Action Representation: Rethinking What to Tokenize for Vision-Language-Action Models

Y. Duan et al., 2026-09-24 — Decomposes action representation into direction and scale for discrete-token VLA learning. Relevance: VLA action tokenization.

ActGaze: Learning Action-Grounded Gaze through Counterfactual Visual Interventions for High-Precision Manipulation

J. Zhu et al., 2026-09-24 — Guides VLA attention via action-grounded gaze and counterfactual visual interventions. Relevance: VLA precision manipulation.

Decoupled Early Exits for Task-Dependent Compute Allocation in Flow-Matching VLAs

R. A. Izzo et al., 2026-09-24 — Decouples early exits to allocate task-dependent compute in flow-matching VLAs. Relevance: VLA inference efficiency.

Self-Adaptive VLA for Robust Robot Deployment

H. Zhang et al., 2026-09-24 — Enables VLA self-adaptation to hardware shifts during deployment. Relevance: VLA test-time robustness.

CrossSafe: Towards Cross-Embodiment Latent Safety Filters

I. Tabbara et al., 2026-09-24 — Learns cross-embodiment latent safety filters for VLA-based robots. Relevance: VLA safety.

AquaMend: Minimal Re-probing and Conditional Rollback for Latent-Belief Failures in Embodied Agents

Y. Liu et al., 2026-09-24 — Compares re-probing and rollback for latent-belief failures under expected loss. Relevance: VLA belief repair.

Embodied Navigation

GPT-6-Astra Lights Up Embodied Navigation: Evaluation in Zero-Shot Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments

G. Dai et al., 2026-09-24 — Evaluates GPT-6-Astra for zero-shot VLN-CE using its own perception, reasoning, and decisions. Relevance: foundation-model navigation.

From Passive Execution to Active Exploration: Agentic Embodied Manipulation in Realistic Environments

S. Ma et al., 2026-09-24 — Moves embodied manipulation from passive execution to active exploration. Relevance: navigation and exploration.

Looks the Same, Answers Differently: Flip-Direction Steering for Robust Vision-Language Reasoning

Y. Jung et al., 2026-09-23 — Uses flip-direction steering to stabilize VLM reasoning under near-identical image changes. Relevance: robust navigation reasoning.

模型压缩与持续学习

LLM Pruning and Inference Optimization

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS] SlackDrive: Reclaiming Runtime Slack for Adaptive Driving Inference

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS] X. Pei et al., 2026-09-23 — Reclaims runtime slack for adaptive driving inference. Relevance: inference optimization.

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS] Task-Induced Riemannian Metrics for Vision Transformer Feature Spaces

🔁 [SEEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS] A. Bond et al., 2026-09-23 — Defines task-induced Riemannian metrics for ViT feature spaces. Relevance: feature-space geometry for efficient vision models.

Continual Learning

Hyperbolic Multimodal Continual Learning: A Closest-Admissible Solution

J. Liu et al., 2026-09-24 — Preserves Lorentz geometry in hyperbolic multimodal continual learning. Relevance: multimodal continual learning.

Adaptive Fisher-Whitened Cross-Covariance for Low-Resource Speech Recognition

A. Mishra et al., 2026-09-24 — Uses Fisher-whitened cross-covariance for parameter-efficient low-resource ASR adaptation. Relevance: continual adaptation.

Automatic Rank Allocation for Low-Rank Adaptation in Large Language Models via lp Regularization

Z. Xie et al., 2026-09-24 — Automatically allocates LoRA ranks with lp regularization. Relevance: efficient continual fine-tuning.

视觉感知

Event-Based Vision

SEE Challenge 2026: Event-Guided Brightness Adjustment Across a Broad Illumination Range

Y. Lu et al., 2026-09-24 — Benchmarks event-guided brightness adjustment across broad illumination. Relevance: event-based restoration.

3D Point Cloud Perception

SARFusion: Scene-Aware Routing Fusion for Robust Camera-LiDAR 3D Object Detection

Y. Zhao et al., 2026-09-24 — Uses scene-aware routing fusion for robust camera-LiDAR 3D detection. Relevance: robust multimodal 3D perception.

M3GD: Multi-Modal Multi-View Geometric Diffusion for Camera--LiDAR Novel View Synthesis

Y. Zhou et al., 2026-09-24 — Combines camera and LiDAR for geometric diffusion-based novel view synthesis. Relevance: 3D scene reconstruction.

Seeing Is Not Measuring: Tool-Augmented Metric Spatial Reasoning for Vision-Language Models

K. Glantz & C. Grange, 2026-09-24 — Equips a small VLM with geometric tools for metric spatial reasoning. Relevance: metric 3D reasoning.

An Automated Georeferencing Technique for Multi-Temporal Stope Point Clouds for Downstream Geotechnical Analysis

D. Patra et al., 2026-09-24 — Automates georeferencing of multi-temporal stope point clouds in GNSS-denied mines. Relevance: point cloud processing.

3D Point Cloud Perception and Tracking

Token Clustering and Semantic Sequence Mamba for Hyperspectral Image Classification

Y. Zhu et al., 2026-09-23 — Applies token clustering and semantic-sequence Mamba to hyperspectral image classification. Relevance: configured sequence-model match, though application is HSI rather than point-cloud tracking.

Cross-Topic Signals

  • Agent harnesses and memory recur across long-horizon VLA, zero-shot navigation, active exploration, and tool-using agent reliability, suggesting shared planning/context-management patterns.
  • Self-improvement and adaptation appear in online RL VLA fine-tuning, self-adaptive VLA, self-play pretraining, skill self-evolution, and environment evolution.
  • Safety and robustness under deployment shifts connect CrossSafe, AquaMend, monitor evasion, trace tampering, and exactly-once tool contracts.
  • Efficient inference and adaptation span decoupled early exits in VLA, SlackDrive runtime slack, LoRA rank allocation, and Fisher-whitened PEFT.
  • Metric/3D geometry remains a common bottleneck across tool-augmented VLM spatial reasoning, camera-LiDAR fusion, georeferencing, M3GD, and point-cloud perception.

Priority Reading

  • Where Does Exactly-Once Live? — Concrete framework for avoiding duplicate side effects in tool-using agents, directly actionable for agent harness and tool-contract design.
  • AdaHVLA — Addresses long-horizon VLA execution with persistent memory and planning, a central bottleneck connecting agent engineering and embodied VLA.
  • Decoupled Early Exits for Flow-Matching VLAs — Task-dependent compute allocation for VLA inference, bridging VLA deployment with pruning and inference optimization.
